title: The 10-Minute Bathroom Grout & Limescale Refresh
excerpt: Dark grout lines make a clean bathroom look dirty. Here's a quick fix.
body:
Grout is porous, so it holds on to soap and dirt. A weekly refresh keeps it light.

- Apply diluted Stain Remover along the grout lines (gloves on, window open)
- Wait 3 minutes
- Scrub with a firm brush
- Rinse and wipe dry
- Open a window to let the room air out

Never mix Stain Remover or any acid cleaner with bleach — the fumes can be dangerous.
